items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: So I guess it was through him that Barney Josephson and Cafe Society heard about us, and hired us to come to New York.

ctx.x: during the whole set -- which was some silly rule, but nonetheless it applied.

So I guess it was through him that Barney Josephson and Cafe Society heard about us, and hired us to come to New York. This is funny. Out here... This was during the War. Was it? Yeah, during the War. Out here we worked from 10 to 2, four hours a night, which was nice. So we found out we were getting forty or fifty dollars a week more to go to the Cafe Society in New York. But we didn't know that in New York you worked from 8 to 4.
